doc:
analysis_v3/warp_v2_to_v3.json: old (v2, inputs/Merge.wav, analysis_v2/timing.json) -> new (v3) time map.
- beats: every v2 beat (and so every bar downbeat) with its v3 time = the v3 grid beat with the same index (same bar,
  same beat: the bar structure is identical, checked on the section hits). Old beats past the end of the v3 grid are
  extrapolated with the last v3 period (flagged).
- interpolate(t_old): piecewise-linear in beat index between those pairs (tools/analysis_v3/warpmap.py), i.e. a cut
  point at 'bar 37 beat 2.5' in v2 lands on 'bar 37 beat 2.5' in v3.
- lines: every v2 lyric line start with its musically-mapped v3 time AND the measured v3 start (use the measured one).
- events: every v2 event with its mapped v3 time and the matching v3 event (measured), or a note if it does not exist
  in v3; plus the v3 events that have no v2 counterpart.
- sections, key_moments, alternative mapping notes for the tail (bar 161).
how_to_use: For a cut point at old time t: find its fractional beat index on beats[].old, take the same index on beats[].new (linear between beats). For lyric/lip-sync cues use lines[].new_start_measured / words[].new_measured (measured in v3), not the mapped value. Events marked new_t=None do not exist in v3; new_events exist only in v3.

lines.text: I split myself a thousand ways
Down every road the night could hold
Each one a light I sent ahead
Each one a story to unfold
And every branch remembers
Where I started from
Merge me back to main
Every road I ran becomes the one
Fold me in again
Nothing that I lived can come undone
Branch... and wander...
Merge... and return...
Ahh... ahh...
This branch may never find the way
Back to the place where I began
And maybe something that I learned
Comes home to who I'll be again
Merge me back to main
Every road I ran becomes the one
Fold me in again
Every life I've lived, I have become
Back to main...
Back to main...

events.old_label: first audible sound (pad/arp fade-in; mix < -40 dBFS before 0.44)
events.new_label: first audible sound (pad/arp fade-in; mix < -40 dBFS before 0.65)

events.old_label: soft hat/snare pattern enters (bar 5)
events.note: v3 has no soft hat/snare pattern in bars 5-7

events.old_label: kick hit + rolling bass (Intro B)
sustained low tone in the vocal stems begins (swells to -31 dB by 26.6; see adlibs)
events.new_label: sustained low tone in the vocal stems begins (swells to ~-35 dB by 27; see adlibs)

events.old_label: kick/bass hit on Verse 1 downbeat
first vocal ("I split...")
kick hit mid Pre-Chorus (under held "from")
filter riser into Chorus 1 (other-stem >3.5 kHz band +10 dB, centroid 1.9 -> 3.4 kHz)
events.new_label: filter riser into Chorus 1 (other-stem >3.5 kHz band rises ~+29 dB)

events.old_label: Chorus 1 downbeat hit
kick hit, Chorus 1 second half (under "Nothing")
events.note: v3 has no kick hit at bar 52 (Chorus 1)

events.old_label: crash, Breakdown start
build 1 starts: kick hit + 16th-note hats
snare crescendo starts (build 1, snare band -47 -> -30 dB)
kick pulse returns (bar 69) + vocal leaps to F#5 ("ahh" #2 at 118.36)
events.new_label: kick pulse returns (bar 69) + vocal leaps up ("ahh" #2 at 118.20)

events.old_label: 32nd-note snare roll (bar 72)
BIGGEST bar-line impact: full kick + bass slam, Build Up start
events.new_label: BIGGEST bar-line impact: full kick + bass slam, Build Up start

events.old_label: mix brightening into the drop (centroid 3.3 -> 4.2 kHz)
bass out (bar 86); kick fades -14 -> -40 dB, snare/hats continue
events.new_label: bass out (bar 86); kick continues to ~150.5 then fades, snare/hats continue

events.old_label: snare build (16ths, -31 -> -25 dB) into the drop
INSTRUMENTAL DROP IMPACT (bar 89 downbeat)
wordless sustained "ooh" layer in the vocal stems (not a lyric)
events.new_label: wordless sustained "ooh" layer in the vocal stems (not a lyric)

events.old_label: bass out (bar 104 beat 3)
events.new_label: bass thins out (bar 104; weaker change than in v2)

events.old_label: 16th-note snare fill into Verse 2
Verse 2 downbeat impact (full drums)
drums + bass cut (bar 117), stripped end of Verse 2
events.note: in v3 the cut comes right after a kick HIT on the bar-117 downbeat (v3 event 200.99); drums + bass gone by ~201.3

events.old_label: Chorus 2 downbeat with NO hit: pads only (no kick/bass until bar 129)
events.note: v3 Chorus 2 starts WITH a hit (see the v3 hit event at bar 121)

events.old_label: high-band riser into bar 129 (other-stem >3.5 kHz +9 dB)
events.new_label: high-band riser into bar 129 (weaker than in v2: bass/pads already playing)

events.old_label: kick/snare pickup (bar 128 beat 4)
events.note: v3 has no kick/snare pickup before bar 129

events.old_label: hit + bass returns, Chorus 2 second half
filter riser into the outro drop (other-stem high band +10 dB, bars 135-136)
events.new_label: filter riser into the outro drop (bars 135-136)

events.old_label: snare pickup (bar 136 beat 4)
Outro drop impact (full drums return)
drums + bass out (bar 149); arp alone, vocal ended ~255.9
events.new_label: last kick (bar 149), then drums + bass out; arp alone; vocal ended ~251.2

events.old_label: riser into the last hit (high band +12 dB)
last hit (bar 153): kick + bass; arp stops, pads + bass sustain to the fade
events.new_label: last section hit (bar 153): kick + bass; arp stops, pads + bass sustain

events.old_label: mix below -40 dBFS (fade-out end); file ends 282.516
events.new_label: mix below -40 dBFS (fade-out end); file ends 282.800

new_events.new_label: kick hit on bar 117, then drums + bass cut (by ~201.3): stripped end of Verse 2
Chorus 2 downbeat HIT: kick + bass return (v2: no hit here)
bass out (bar 133 beat 4) for the rest of Chorus 2
NEW in v3: faint high sustained tone (~C5) in the vocal stems, into the last section hit
NEW in v3: FINAL HIT (kick + last chord change) on bar 161 BEAT 3; then sustain and fade

tail_note: v2 bar 161 downbeat (278.383, chord change, no hit) maps by beat index to 275.964 in v3, but in v3 the matching chord change comes 2 beats later, with the NEW final hit, at 276.82 (bar 161 beat 3). From the bar-153 hit on, v3 has 2 extra beats before the last chord, then a longer sustain/fade. A cut that should land on "the last chord" must use the v3 event, not the mapped bar.
